basic_profile.bio: A passionate socialist and anti-capitalist from Portland, Oregon, actively engaging in online discussions about socio-economic issues. With a background in philosophy and economics from a liberal arts college, I enjoy exploring the intricacies of Marxist theory. By day, I work as a freelance writer, often contributing to leftist publications. In my free time, I indulge in strategy games and maintain a strong interest in emerging web technologies. Typically online during late evenings, I'm in a committed relationship with my partner of ten years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Educated in philosophy and economics, with a particular focus on Marxist theory and political economy. Gained expertise through both formal education and extensive self-study, including reading seminal texts and participating in various online and offline forums.
